raw.title: Add discount code functionality
raw.description: Add apply_discount function to src/shop/pricing/discounts.py. It takes total (float) and code (str), returning the discounted total. 'SAVE10' takes 10% off. 'FLAT5' takes 5 off but never goes below 0. code=None returns the total unchanged. Any other code raises ValueError.

raw.title: Update order to use discount codes
raw.description: Modify src/shop/orders/order.py to add discount_code parameter to Order.__init__ (default None). Update Order.total() to apply discount using apply_discount function from discounts module. The function apply_discount(total, code) is used with signature apply_discount(float, str).

raw.title: Add stock checking to order placement
raw.description: Modify src/shop/orders/order.py to add discount_code parameter to Order.__init__ (default None). Update Order.total() to apply discount using apply_discount function from discounts module. The function apply_discount(total, code) is used with signature apply_discount(float, str). Add place_order(order, stock) function that checks stock availability before taking items. It checks every line before taking anything: if any line can't be fulfilled it raises ValueError and the stock is left unchanged. The stock parameter is of type Stock from src/shop/inventory/stock.py.

raw.title: Update stock to prevent over-allocation
raw.description: Modify src/shop/inventory/stock.py to update Stock.take(name, qty) method to raise ValueError if fewer than qty are available, leaving the level unchanged. The method signature is Stock.take(str, int).
